messages.content: Nikola Tesla was a Serbian-American inventor and electrical engineer known for his work on alternating-current power systems.
You probably mean Nikola Tesla. He was a Serbian-American inventor and electrical engineer known for developing alternating-current power technology.
No. Nikola Tesla was a man, born in 1856 in Smiljan in the Austrian Empire, in present-day Croatia.
Tesla was born in the Austrian Empire to a Serbian family and later became a naturalized American citizen.
Tesla developed important alternating-current motors and power systems and contributed to radio, wireless transmission, and high-voltage engineering.
